description: Read one website's stored audit settings: its audit level (quick, surface, full or custom) with the page cap, crawl strategy, rendering and external link checks it sets, the crawl depth, crawl scope, include/exclude patterns and internal link checks, whether broken link alerts are on (broken_link_alerts, Pro and Team), whether the user confirmed the site is theirs (ownership_confirmed), its disable_rules (rule ids and category globs switched off for its cloud audits, with disabled_rule_count rules matched), and its recurring-audit schedule. runs_as is how the next audit runs on the organization's plan (a level or page cap the plan does not run is held to the plan there, with a notice) and credits_per_run_max is the most one audit of it can cost. schedule says whether recurring audits are on; pending_first_audit: true means they switch on by themselves after the site's first successful audit, and estimated_cost is the most they spend per run, week and month. squirrelscan audits are meant to be tailored to each site through rules: rule classes that do not apply to a site (no privacy, about or contact pages on a hobby site, say) are disabled in its disable_rules, not re-reported on every audit, so the score reflects what matters for that site. Local runs read the disable list in squirrel.toml; cloud runs cannot see the repository and use the website's stored disable_rules.

website_id.description: Website id from list_websites, run_audit or add_website.
